Normal-form plus stable-foliation asymptotic integration gives the t-decay limits. Exact-rational SymPy checks were reproduced, but finite tests were not substituted for infinite arguments. Verified domain includes a2>c2*a1/b1 and 3/2<b<2 for the normalized classification.
